t: Transected Achilles tendon heals faster with BPC-157, rats (2003)
who: Rats with a cut Achilles tendon
f: BPC-157 rats healed with stronger tendons, better walking scores and more collagen, and the gap closed; untreated rats healed poorly.

t: Transected quadriceps muscle heals with BPC-157, rats (2006)
who: Rats with a fully cut thigh muscle
f: Daily BPC-157 reconnected the cut muscle, restored strength and walking over 72 days and limited wasting.

t: BPC-157 raises VEGF and new vessels in muscle and tendon healing, rats (2009)
who: Rats with crushed or cut muscle and tendon, plus cell culture
f: Treated injuries grew more organised new vessels with higher VEGF; BPC-157 had no direct vessel effect on cells in a dish.

t: BPC-157 heals cysteamine colitis and colon anastomosis, rats (2013)
who: Rats with chemically induced colitis
f: BPC-157 healed colitis and colon surgical joins that did not heal in untreated rats; it also limited nerve damage in a brain injury model.

t: BPC-157 speeds sciatic nerve healing after cut, rats (2009)
who: Rats with a cut sciatic nerve
f: BPC-157 rats regrew nerve fibres faster, with better nerve signals and walking than controls.

t: Retatrutide phase 2a trial in fatty liver disease (2024)
who: 98 adults with obesity and fatty liver, 48 weeks
f: Liver fat fell about 81–82% at the 8 and 12 mg doses by week 24; 79–86% of those people reached normal liver fat, none on placebo.

t: TRIUMPH-1: retatrutide in obesity or overweight
who: 2,335 adults with obesity or overweight, no diabetes, 80 weeks
f: Registry record only. Results are not posted here yet; the 28.3% weight loss figure comes from a company press release.

t: Retatrutide delays stomach emptying, phase 1b (2023)
who: Phase 1b trial in people with type 2 diabetes, plus mice
f: Retatrutide slowed stomach emptying after a dose; the effect faded with repeated dosing.

t: TRIUMPH-4: retatrutide in obesity with knee osteoarthritis
who: 445 adults with obesity and knee osteoarthritis
f: Registry record only. It measures knee pain on the WOMAC scale; results are not posted here yet.

t: Tirzepatide vs semaglutide on insulin release and sensitivity (2022)
who: 117 adults with type 2 diabetes, 28 weeks
f: Tirzepatide improved insulin release and insulin sensitivity more than semaglutide, and lowered glucagon after meals.

t: Tirzepatide briefly delays stomach emptying (2020)
who: Mice, and people in a 4-week phase 1 study
f: Tirzepatide slowed stomach emptying after the first dose, much like GLP-1 drugs; the effect faded with repeat doses.

t: Tirzepatide acts on fat cells through the GIP receptor (2024)
who: Human fat cells in the lab and obese mice
f: GIP receptor activation helped fat cells take up sugar and fat after meals and release fat when fasting. The mouse part used a related GIP drug.

t: SURMOUNT-OSA: tirzepatide for sleep apnoea and obesity (2024)
who: Adults with obesity and moderate to severe sleep apnoea, two trials, 52 weeks
f: Breathing pauses fell by about 25–29 events per hour vs about 5 on placebo, with weight loss and lower blood pressure.

t: Food craving brain signal quiets in one person on tirzepatide (2025)
who: One person with obesity
f: Brain signals tied to food craving went quiet after starting tirzepatide, then came back after about 5 months.

t: SELECT: semaglutide and heart events in obesity (2023)
who: 17,604 adults with heart disease and overweight, no diabetes, about 3 years
f: Heart attack, stroke or heart death fell 20%: 6.5% on semaglutide vs 8.0% on placebo.

t: FLOW: semaglutide and kidney disease in type 2 diabetes (2024)
who: 3,533 adults with type 2 diabetes and kidney disease, about 3.4 years
f: Major kidney events fell 24% and kidney function declined more slowly; heart deaths also fell.

t: TRIUMPH-4: retatrutide in obesity with knee osteoarthritis
who: 445 adults with obesity and knee osteoarthritis
f: Registry record only. It measures knee pain on the WOMAC scale; results are not posted here yet.

t: BPC-157 grows new vessels into healing Achilles tendon, rats (2008)
who: Rats with a cut Achilles tendon, first 4 days
f: BPC-157 lowered inflammation and grew more new blood vessels, and walking recovered sooner.

t: Achilles tendon-to-bone healing with BPC-157, rats (2006)
who: Rats with the Achilles tendon cut from the heel bone
f: BPC-157 reattached tendon to bone with better strength and walking, and countered steroid-slowed healing.

t: BPC-157 calms inflammation in early Achilles healing, rats (2008)
who: Rats with a cut Achilles tendon, first 4 days
f: BPC-157 lowered inflammation and grew more new blood vessels, and walking recovered sooner.

t: Knee injections of BPC-157, 16-patient chart review (2021)
who: 16 patients reached by phone after knee injections, chart review
f: 14 of 16 (87.5%) reported knee pain relief: 11 of 12 on BPC-157 alone, 3 of 4 on BPC-157 plus TB4. No control group.

t: AOD9604 knee injections rebuild cartilage, rabbits (2015)
who: 32 rabbits with induced knee osteoarthritis
f: AOD9604 knee injections reduced cartilage damage and limping; it worked best combined with hyaluronic acid.

t: Collagen peptides plus training enlarge Achilles tendon (2022)
who: 40 young men, 14 weeks of heavy training
f: Achilles tendon size grew 11% with 5 g collagen peptides vs 4.7% on placebo. Another trial (2023) found no extra tendon gain.

t: Collagen peptide trial in knee osteoarthritis (2015)
who: Adults with knee osteoarthritis, 13 weeks
f: Pain, stiffness and quality of life scores improved on collagen peptides and not on placebo.

t: GHK-Cu protects against lung fibrosis, mice (2019)
who: Mice with induced lung fibrosis
f: GHK-Cu reduced lung inflammation, scarring and collagen build-up.

t: Copper peptide gel speeds healing of ischemic wounds, rats (2003)
who: 24 rats with poorly supplied skin wounds, 13 days
f: Copper peptide gel shrank wounds 64.5% vs 28.2% untreated, with lower inflammation markers.

t: Tesamorelin cuts visceral fat in HIV, phase 3 (2007)
who: 412 adults with HIV and belly fat, 26 weeks
f: Deep belly fat fell 15.2% on tesamorelin and rose 5.0% on placebo; triglycerides improved.

t: Tesamorelin lowers visceral and liver fat in HIV (2014)
who: 50 adults with HIV and belly fat, 6 months
f: Tesamorelin lowered deep belly fat and modestly lowered liver fat compared with placebo.

t: GHRH (tesamorelin) and cognition in older adults and MCI (2012)
who: 152 adults aged 55–87, healthy or with mild memory loss, 20 weeks
f: Tesamorelin improved thinking scores, mainly planning and focus, with a trend for verbal memory.

t: MOTS-c improves insulin sensitivity via muscle, mice (2015)
who: Mice on a high-fat diet and ageing mice
f: MOTS-c acted mainly on muscle, prevented insulin resistance and blocked diet-induced weight gain.

t: MOTS-c prevents diet-induced obesity, mice (2015)
who: Mice on a high-fat diet and ageing mice
f: MOTS-c acted mainly on muscle, prevented insulin resistance and blocked diet-induced weight gain.

t: MOTS-c prevents insulin resistance, mice (2015)
who: Mice on a high-fat diet and ageing mice
f: MOTS-c acted mainly on muscle, prevented insulin resistance and blocked diet-induced weight gain.

t: MOTS-c raises physical capacity in old mice (2021)
who: Young, middle-aged and old mice, plus exercising people
f: MOTS-c raised running capacity at every age, including in old mice; exercise raised MOTS-c in people.

t: Thymosin β4 aids heart cell survival and repair, mice (2004)
who: Heart cells in the lab and mice after a heart attack
f: Thymosin β4 helped heart cells move and survive and improved heart function after injury.

t: Thymosin β4 aids heart cell survival and repair, mice (2004)
who: Heart cells in the lab and mice after a heart attack
f: Thymosin β4 helped heart cells move and survive and improved heart function after injury.

t: Thymosin β4 speeds wound healing, rats (1999)
who: Rats with full-thickness skin wounds
f: Wounds closed 42–61% faster with thicker collagen and more new vessels; it also made skin cells move.

t: Thymosin β4 raises new vessels in healing wounds, rats (1999)
who: Rats with full-thickness skin wounds
f: Wounds closed 42–61% faster with thicker collagen and more new vessels; it also made skin cells move.

t: Ipamorelin, the first selective GH secretagogue, rats and pigs (1998)
who: Rat pituitary cells, rats and pigs
f: Ipamorelin released growth hormone as strongly as GHRP-6 without raising cortisol or other hormones.

t: Ipamorelin raises bone mineral content, rats (2000)
who: Adult female rats, 12 weeks
f: Ipamorelin raised bone mineral content, mainly by making bones grow bigger rather than denser.

t: CD38 drives age-related NAD decline, mice (2016)
who: Ageing mice and CD38 knockout mice
f: CD38 rises with age and drives the fall in NAD; mice lacking CD38 kept NAD levels and healthier mitochondria.

t: Semax raises BDNF and TrkB in the hippocampus, rats (2006)
who: Rats given intranasal Semax
f: One dose raised BDNF in the hippocampus by 1.4 times and improved learning in a conditioning test.

t: TAZPOWER: elamipretide in Barth syndrome, phase 2/3 (2021)
who: 12 people with Barth syndrome, then an open-label extension
f: No benefit in the blinded 12-week phase; by week 36 of open-label use, walking distance rose 96 m and strength improved.

t: SS-31 reduces ischemic kidney injury, rats (2011)
who: Rats with kidney blood flow cut and restored
f: SS-31 protected kidney mitochondria, sped energy recovery and reduced kidney cell death and inflammation.

t: Bendavia (SS-31) shrinks heart reperfusion injury, animals (2012)
who: Sheep, rabbits and guinea pigs after heart blood flow returned
f: Bendavia (SS-31) reduced heart damage size by 15–42% depending on the model.

t: Selank vs medazepam in anxiety disorder, 62 patients (2008)
who: 62 patients with anxiety disorder or neurasthenia
f: Selank calmed anxiety about as well as medazepam and also eased fatigue. No placebo group.

t: Selank shifts IL-6 and Th1/Th2 cytokines in anxious patients (2008)
who: Blood cells and serum from patients with anxiety disorders
f: Selank changed IL-6 activity and shifted the Th1/Th2 immune balance over 14 days of treatment.

t: Oral KPV reduces colitis via PepT1, mice (2008)
who: Human gut and immune cells, and mice with colitis
f: KPV entered cells via PepT1, blocked NF-κB inflammation signals, and oral KPV reduced colitis in mice.

t: KPV blocks NF-κB in gut and immune cells (2008)
who: Human gut and immune cells, and mice with colitis
f: KPV entered cells via PepT1, blocked NF-κB inflammation signals, and oral KPV reduced colitis in mice.

t: Melanotan II tans human skin, pilot phase 1 (1996)
who: 3 healthy men, 2 weeks
f: Low doses tanned the face and upper body; side effects were nausea, yawning and spontaneous erections.

t: Melanotan II starts erections, placebo crossover in 10 men (1998)
who: 10 men with psychogenic erectile dysfunction, crossover
f: 8 of 10 got clear erections on Melanotan II vs few on placebo; nausea and yawning were common.
